title: CDN manifest
description: Translation files published by the JavaScript and translation files CDN add-ons.

locales.description: Published files keyed by Weblate language code; an empty object is allowed. Files are sorted by URL.

url.description: File URL relative to the manifest URL, including percent-encoded nested paths. Published files are mutable.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the published bytes.

size.description: File size in bytes; empty files are allowed.
